questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.answer: My name is Rahul Menon. I have two years of experience in Python development. I know Python, Django and SQL. I worked on student management and library management projects.

questions.question: What are your strengths?
questions.answer: My strengths are hard work, teamwork and willingness to learn. I try to complete the assigned work on time.

questions.question: How do you handle a difficult task?
questions.answer: I try to understand the task and search for solutions. If I cannot solve it, I ask my senior developer for help.
